conviction_note: The bar this name is actually judged on is IFIS's quarterly 経常利益 consensus of ¥23,100M for Q1 (+7.4% YoY), which sits above a company that has delivered 経常 +4.5% for FY2026 with gross margin down 110bp and operating expenses up 11.2% as cloud displaces licence revenue; the stock has fallen on each of the last four prints and has run +4.4% in the five sessions into this one on a US-parent read-through that does not reach its P&L. I hold expected_move well inside the sum of the findings (-3.5) because the honest counterweight is real and large: the Q4 FY2026 revenue exit rate was +11.2% YoY against a full-year consensus of +7.1%, so a visible top-line beat is more likely than not and this shareholder base has bought revenue acceleration before (+10.9% and +10.4% reactions in the 2024-25 cadence window).
bar: Two bars, stated together because Japan's convention and this name's wire coverage differ. (1) The company's own FY2027 range, given with the 2026-06-25 FY2026 決算短信: revenue +6.0% to +10.0% and EPS ¥525.00-¥540.00 (vs ¥495.97 actual FY2026) — https://note.com/yamashantoushi/n/nfe6baad90538 and the filing itself at https://finance-frontend-pc-dist.west.edge.storage-yahoo.jp/disclosure/20260625/20260624579200.pdf . (2) The number the 決算速報 wires lead with: IFIS 株予報 quarterly consensus, Q1 経常利益 ¥23,100M, full-year ¥101,125M — https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=4716 (read 2026-09-18). Q1 FY2026 経常 was approximately ¥21,500M (OP ¥21,128M, from the quarterly table at https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/4716/finance/ ), so the Q1 bar is roughly +7.4% YoY.
positioning_check: JPX 空売り残高報告 register as of 2026-09-18 carries NO disclosed short position in 4716 at or above the 0.5% threshold (short_ratio 0.0%, zero disclosed sellers) — https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html . 信用倍率 8.92 (margin longs 8.9x margin shorts), i.e. leveraged retail length and effectively no short base. There is no single-stock option market and therefore no skew to read. Implication: no squeeze fuel on a good print, and margin longs to liquidate on a bad one — the positioning is asymmetric to the downside, which is the same direction as my findings. Daily turnover ¥1.89bn median (20d) so liquidity is not a constraint. TSE daily price band at ¥9,346 is ±¥1,500 (~16%), far outside my sizing.

findings.finding: The quarter's own consensus bar (経常利益 ¥23,100M, +7.4% YoY) and the full-year one behind it (OP ¥100,389M, +11.8%) both require an operating-margin reversal that this company's disclosed mix shift argues against: FY2026 delivered revenue +8.2% but OP only +3.4%, gross margin 46.1%->45.0% and implied operating expenses +11.2%, because cloud went from 23.5% to 29.2% of revenue (+34.3%) while the high-margin software licence line fell 2.1% and support grew only 1.1% despite an 8% annual price increase.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line the name is repeatedly sold on. Last year's same quarter (Q1 FY2026, printed late September 2025) missed EPS by 2.8% and the baseline's cadence window records -6.16%. The FY2026 print on 2026-06-25 reported record revenue and cloud +34.3% but 経常 ¥91,373M against an IFIS consensus of ¥93,100M (-1.9%) and the stock closed 2026-06-26 at ¥8,088 against ¥8,223, -1.64%. The Q3 print on 2026-03-24 was also sold (株価反落, baseline -4.37% on 03-25). Four consecutive prints, four negative reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had marked the bar to the run rate, the sell-side full-year consensus would not sit at OP +11.8% on revenue +7.1% — 470bp of operating leverage — nor at net income ¥70,150M, which is ¥1.0bn ABOVE the top of the company's own EPS guidance range of ¥540 (≈¥69.1bn). It would also not carry a ¥11,467 target price, 23% above spot, with a 4.0/5 average rating. The arithmetic runs the other way: holding gross margin flat at 45.0% and hitting consensus OP would require absolute operating expenses to FALL about 4% after a year in which they rose 11.2%, and cloud rising to roughly 35% of revenue makes flat gross margin itself optimistic.
findings.independence: Segment and margin detail cross-checks against two further sources that are not the IFIS page: the quarterly results table at https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/4716/finance/ (Q1-Q4 FY2026 revenue ¥66,275/68,402/71,993/78,403M and OP ¥21,128/21,531/24,364/22,772M, i.e. a 31.9% Q1 margin falling to 29.0% in Q4) and the segment breakdown at https://note.com/yamashantoushi/n/nfe6baad90538 (cloud ¥83,184M +34.3%, support ¥113,678M +1.1%, licence ¥47,618M -2.1%, hardware ¥15,048M -3.5%, services ¥25,543M +2.6%, summing to the reported ¥285,073M). The 8% support price increase is independently documented by a reseller notice at https://corp.ba-net.co.jp/news/20260625_1 — and it is the FOURTH consecutive 8% year, so it is a run-rate, not a new lift, which is why support revenue grows 1.1%: the installed base is attriting into cloud.

findings.finding: 4716 has rallied +4.4% in the five sessions into the print (¥8,954 close on 2026-09-10 to ¥9,346 on 2026-09-17, with a single +4.09% day on 09-14 that has no company-specific disclosure behind it), tracking the US parent's 2026-09-10 Q1 FY2027 blowout — revenue $19.35bn vs $19.14bn, OCI +121%, RPO $664bn — none of which reaches 日本オラクル's P&L, since 4716's cloud line is ¥83bn of domestic OCI/SaaS and it books none of the hyperscale AI backlog; ORCL itself closed lower on its own beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The press attributes 4716's moves to the parent's tape in both directions — the June 2026 sell-off was explained partly by ORCL's own decline. The last time the market held 4716 as an AI proxy it de-rated from ¥17,875 (June 2025) to below ¥8,100 by late June 2026, roughly -55%, without a single quarter in which 4716's own revenue growth fell below +7%. The proxy trade has unwound violently before; the last four prints, which is when the domestic P&L is actually shown, were all sold.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had separated the two entities, 4716 would not have gained 4.4% in the week that ORCL fell about 2% on the day of its own beat and 4.7% over the following sessions; the two prices would have diverged in the same direction, not opposite ones. The baseline's 20-day run-up of -0.42% hides this entirely — it nets the early-September drawdown to ¥8,850 against the post-ORCL bounce — so the free control reads this name as flat when the five-day run-in is the thing that has to be justified on 09-24. Add to that 信用倍率 8.92 and zero disclosed shorts: the bounce is levered length with nothing to cover into it.
findings.independence: The ORCL reaction is sourced separately from the price series: https://en.cryptonomist.ch/2026/09/15/oracle-stock-falls-4-7-despite-30-revenue-surge-charts-stay-bearish/ (2026-09-15) and https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/10/oracle-orcl-q1-earnings-report-2027.html for the parent's Q1 FY2027 figures. Note this finding shares NO document with finding 1 — one is the consensus/mix arithmetic, the other is the tape and the positioning — but they are the same trade and I have sized the total below their sum accordingly.
